Earthquakes (EQ), tropical cyclones (TC), floods (FL), volcanoes (VO), droughts (DR), wildfires (WF) with Green/Orange/Red alert levels and estimated exposed population; GeoJSON properties include iso3, affectedcountries, alertlevel, alertscore, severitydata, glide and links to the report, footprint and Copernicus products. Verified 2026-11-16: RSS had 232 items (228 Green, 4 Orange); search?country=Kazakhstan&fromDate=2024-01-01 returned one event (FL 1102548 'Flood in Kazakhstan', Orange, 2024-03-28 to 2024-04-10); eventsbyarea with a WKT polygon of the Central Asia box (46-88 E, 35-56 N) and days=365 returned 20 events including two Green earthquakes in Tajikistan on 2026-11-03, Hindu Kush and Xinjiang earthquakes and drought DR 1027491 (China, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Russia, since 2026-06-21); emdat/getemdatbyiso3?iso3=KAZ returned 50 EM-DAT records (latest 2024-0035-KAZ earthquake, 2024-0191-KAZ and 2024-0198-KAZ floods, 2026-0622-KAZ water event) with fields such as numaffected, numhomeless, insurdam, magnitude, latitude/longitude.
feeds.update: Near real time; RSS pubDate at fetch (2026-11-16 02:35 UTC) was within the hour. Exact latency per hazard is not documented on the fetched pages.
feeds.license: RSS channel declares copyright 'public domain'; no API key observed. Full terms-of-use page not fetched.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: first trigger for the event list and the headline alert level (alert colour, exposed population, footprint polygon on the damage-overview map). Risk screen: recent-event history per country via the iso3/country filters and the EM-DAT mirror.

feeds.api: FDSN query with a Central Asia bounding box: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=geojson&starttime=YYYY-MM-DD&minmagnitude=4&minlatitude=35&maxlatitude=56&minlongitude=46&maxlongitude=88 (limit parameter range 1-20000) | summary feeds: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/{all|1.0|2.5|4.5|significant}_{hour|day|week|month}.geojson | per-event detail GeoJSON (properties.detail) lists products such as shakemap, losspager, dyfi, ground-failure, moment-tensor
feeds.covers_ja: Global. Test query on 2026-11-16 (api 2.8.4) returned M4+ events since 2026-10-01 inside the Central Asia bounding box (Hindu Kush, Afghanistan; Kuqa, Xinjiang). The 4.5_day feed returned 10 events. In the significant_month feed every M5.7+ event carried shakemap and losspager products (e.g., M7.0 Nagqu, China, PAGER orange; M5.7 Khuzdar, Pakistan, PAGER yellow), whereas a M4.9 Afghanistan event had only origin and phase-data, so ShakeMap/PAGER cannot be assumed for small Central Asian events.

feeds.license: U.S. Government work (public domain); no API key. Statement not re-read on the fetched pages.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: earthquake forcing panel (magnitude, depth, epicentre, aftershock list), ShakeMap intensity contours and PAGER alert level for the damage overview. Risk screen: historical catalogue behind the quake hazard and seasonality-free history list.

feeds.provider: Kazselezashchita, Ministry of Emergency Situations of Kazakhstan

Monitoring network: 11 emergency mechanised brigades, 79 year-round observation posts plus 38 seasonal posts (Kazpravda); automated early warning system for the Talgar basin (lakes 8, 10 and 19) handed over by UNESCO on 2026-08-18 with data streamed to the Kazselezashchita control centre in Almaty; warnings to residents by SMS and through DChS Almaty / MES channels.
feeds.format: SMS, press releases via MES and akimat
feeds.covers_ja: Almaty city and Almaty Region mountain basins (Kishi and Ulken Almaty, Talgar, Esik), East Kazakhstan (13 mudflow-prone basins, 144 moraine lakes) and other mountain regions.
feeds.update: Seasonal (mudflow season roughly May-September), event-driven alerts.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: landslide/mudflow forcing (moraine-lake status, controlled drawdowns) for the Almaty scenario; risk screen: landslide hazard narrative.

feeds.name: Almaty power outage information: AZhK (Alatau Zharyk Company) outage map and KEGOC system-operator notices
feeds.provider: Alatau Zharyk Company (distribution grid, Almaty) and KEGOC (national grid operator)
feeds.api: No public API. AZhK publishes planned-maintenance schedules and a map of emergency shutdowns on its website (azhk.kz, per Tengrinews/Orda); KEGOC statements at https://www.kegoc.kz/en (e.g., restoration of the Almaty power hub at 16:12 on 2026-08-14 after a Central Asian grid failure linked to a Toktogul HPP turbine shutdown; AZhK lifted restrictions at 19:00).
feeds.covers_ja: Almaty city and nearby Almaty Region (AZhK); national transmission grid (KEGOC). Frequent snow- and heat-related district outages reported in 2026.
feeds.update: Planned schedules in advance; emergency map as events occur.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: utility status in the sites and supply-chain panel; personal dashboard: power restoration tile (manual entry in the mock).

feeds.name: Almaty city akimat and Department of Emergency Situations (DChS Almaty) notifications
feeds.provider: Akimat of Almaty city; Department of Emergency Situations of Almaty (MES)
feeds.api: No public API. DChS Almaty page: https://www.gov.kz/memleket/entities/emer-alm?lang=en | district akimat Telegram channels (all eight districts; e.g., Almaly: https://t.me/almalyaudany) | road and transport channel https://t.me/AlmatyJoly and bot @AlmatyJolybot | Mass Alert cell broadcast covering 90-97% of base stations | sirens and phone alerts tested in the Zher-2025 drill. City-wide official Telegram handle not confirmed.
feeds.format: HTML news, Telegram, Cell Broadcast, sirens
feeds.covers_ja: Almaty city (about 2.2 million residents): earthquake alerts, mudflow season notices, snow and heat advisories, evacuation drills.
feeds.update: Event-driven.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Personal dashboard (Almaty presets): official city notices and evacuation assembly points; live reporting: incident feed for the M7.3 Almaty scenario.

feeds.name: Uzhydromet forecasts and hazardous-weather warnings
feeds.api: No public API found. Daily 'forecast for tomorrow' and warnings posted as news on the gov.uz portal (e.g., https://gov.uz/ru/hydromet/news/view/235785); warnings relayed by Kun.uz, UzDaily, Tashkent Times; UzDaily reports an official Uzhydromet Telegram channel (handle not confirmed).
feeds.covers_ja: Uzbekistan: mudflow and flash-flood warnings for foothill and mountain districts of up to nine regions (e.g., 2026-11-06 nine regions; 2026-11-13 eight regions), avalanche risk (Kamchik Pass, April 2026), heat (Tashkent near 40 C in June 2026), cold snaps (2026-11-05 to 08).
feeds.update: Daily forecast; warnings as needed (often 1-3 days ahead).
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: forcing panel text for Tashkent, Fergana and Samarkand sites (heat watch scenario); personal dashboard: warning tile.

feeds.name: Ministry of Emergency Situations of Uzbekistan (FVV): 112, mobile app, mosque loudspeaker early warning
feeds.provider: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Republic of Uzbekistan (Favqulodda vaziyatlar vazirligi)
feeds.api: No public API. Channels: emergency dispatch 112 (MES appeal, September 2025); ministry mobile app with push notifications for 101/102/103/1050 (UNDP presentation); trust line (95) 772-10-50; mosque loudspeaker alert pilot launched March 2026 with UNDP (works without mobile network or power); first national standard for emergency early warning systems adopted. Legacy domain fvv.uz per Wikipedia (third_party). Official Telegram channel not confirmed; the ministry has warned about impostors.
feeds.format: Voice, mobile app push, loudspeakers, HTML news
feeds.covers_ja: Uzbekistan nationwide: mudflow threats, cold-weather and carbon-monoxide safety, avalanche control at Kamchik Pass, earthquake drills.
feeds.update: Event-driven.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: official alert timeline; personal dashboard: emergency numbers (112, 1050) and alert-channel checklist.

feeds.name: Tashkent city hokimiyat announcements and Telegram
feeds.api: No public API. Official Telegram channel https://t.me/poytaxt_uz (cited by the Chilanzar district administration site) | feedback Telegram bot announced by the hokimiyat | press service +998 71 210 01 63 | district portals such as https://chilonzor.tashkent.uz/en | emergencies: call 112.
feeds.covers_ja: Tashkent city (about 3 million residents): heavy snowfall and wind advisories, winter-preparation task force, water accumulation reports via People's Control portal.
feeds.update: Daily news; event-driven alerts.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Personal dashboard (Tashkent presets): city notices and services; live reporting: incident feed for Tashkent scenarios.

feeds.name: Kyrgyzhydromet forecasts and storm warnings
feeds.provider: Hydrometeorological Service under the Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic (Kyrgyzhydromet)
feeds.api: No public API found. About page https://meteo.kg/en/pages/about-us (tasks include forecasting dangerous hydrometeorological phenomena and avalanche danger); warnings relayed by 24.kg and Kaktus.media; MES KR also issues warnings.
feeds.covers_ja: Kyrgyzstan: strong wind in Bishkek and Chuy region (e.g., 2026-03-04), storm warning 2026-04-15 to 17, cold snaps, heavy rain and mudflow forecasts for mountain and foothill areas.
feeds.update: Daily forecasts; warnings as needed.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: forcing panel text for Bishkek and Osh sites; personal dashboard: warning tile.

feeds.name: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic: 112 service and '112 - Kyrgyzstan' app
feeds.provider: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic
feeds.api: No public API. Unified 112 emergency service (fire, rescue, police, ambulance, gas); mobile app '112 - Kyrgyzstan' for reporting incidents with photo/video/audio (WFP/UK supported; Android availability reported, iOS status unclear); contact mchs@mail.gov.kg. Alternative domain mes.kg/en per Wikipedia (third_party). Official Telegram channel not confirmed.
feeds.covers_ja: Kyrgyzstan nationwide: earthquakes, mudflows and floods, avalanches, strong wind warnings for Bishkek and Chuy.
feeds.update: Event-driven.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: official alert timeline; personal dashboard: emergency numbers and reporting app.

feeds.name: Bishkek city hall (Meria) services and hotlines
feeds.api: No public API. Portals meria.kg, e-meria.kg and https://bishkek.gov.kg/en (English posts); 'My City' (Moy Gorod) mobile app; hotlines 185 and 1840 (24 h) and 1850 (rapid-response service), fallen trees 0770 83 00 06 (per Kaktus.media relays). Digital services suffered a DDoS attack in January 2025. Official Telegram channel not confirmed.
feeds.covers_ja: Bishkek city: heating-season breakdowns, icicle and tree-fall hazards, frost shelters, traffic-light outages.
feeds.update: Daily news; event-driven.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Personal dashboard (Bishkek presets): city hotlines and notices; live reporting: incident feed.

feeds.covers_ja: Tajikistan: forecasts and hazardous-weather information for Dushanbe, Khujand, Khatlon and GBAO; avalanche and mudflow season.
feeds.update: Daily forecasts (warning cadence not documented).
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: forcing panel text for Dushanbe and Khujand sites.

feeds.name: Hydrometeorological Service of Turkmenistan (Turkmenhydromet) forecasts
feeds.provider: Hydrometeorological Service under the Ministry of Environmental Protection of Turkmenistan
feeds.api: No public API. Weekly forecasts republished on the Ministry of Environmental Protection site (turkmenhemrasy.gov.tm, English) and in the Turkmenistan newspaper; a daily bulletin covers the five velayats and Ashgabat for three days (2021 WMO presentation, dated). The service's own domain (meteo.gov.tm) could not be confirmed.
feeds.covers_ja: Turkmenistan: weekly temperature, rain/snow and wind outlooks (e.g., night temperatures to -4 C, daytime peaks above 40 C in summer).
feeds.update: Weekly (plus daily bulletin per older source).
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: forcing panel text for Ashgabat and Turkmenbashi sites (heat, dust, cold).

feeds.name: Turkmenistan Main Directorate of Civil Defence and Rescue Operations (Ministry of Defence)
feeds.provider: Ministry of Defence of Turkmenistan, Main Directorate of Civil Defence and Rescue Operations
feeds.api: No public feed found. The directorate (headed by a Deputy Defence Minister) handles natural-disaster prevention and response and domestic fires; news appears via the state agency TDH (turkmenistan.gov.tm), the Foreign Ministry site and UN Turkmenistan releases; an Interagency Working Group for DRR was launched with UNDRR.
feeds.covers_ja: Turkmenistan nationwide: earthquakes (Ashgabat 1948 legacy), floods, fires; public alerting mechanism not documented in open sources.
feeds.update: Irregular.
feeds.license: Not stated.
feeds.use_in_app_ja: Live reporting: reference link only; personal dashboard: emergency numbers from contacts data.

_gaps: ReliefWeb API v2 requires a pre-approved appname (HTTP 403 observed with a generic name; v1 returns HTTP 410). Only the keyless country RSS (advanced-search=(PC130) for Kazakhstan, taxonomy term 130) was verified; term ids for Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan were not looked up.

ThinkHazard: www.thinkhazard.org returned HTTP 404 for every path during this session while thinkhazard.org worked; the documented /en/divisions/search endpoint returned 404; Tajikistan and Turkmenistan division codes remain unresolved (239 and 250 return 404).
Open-Meteo flood and air-quality hosts are blocked by the proxy; parameters and licence come from search snippets and client libraries, not from live calls.

EMSC, Copernicus Rapid Mapping dashboard API, GloFAS/EWDS, GFM API, NASA FIRMS, NASA GIBS, OpenAQ, IQAir, WorldPop and CESDRR: hosts blocked; URLs, rate limits and licences are snippet-level only and should be re-checked before production use.

EM-DAT: public.emdat.be and doc.emdat.be are blocked; access terms (registration, non-commercial, no redistribution, API for commercial licensees only) come from search snippets. GDACS exposes EM-DAT records through its API (verified for KAZ) but the licence for that mirror was not checked.

GDACS: search (country filter), eventsbyarea (WKT polygon) and the EM-DAT mirror were all verified live on 2026-11-16; the terms-of-use page and per-hazard update latency were not fetched, and the licence of the EM-DAT records served through GDACS was not checked.
GEM: licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 verified in the Kazakhstan README; the release version (v2026.0.0 per project brief) was not verified.

National feeds (all five countries): every government host is blocked, so URLs come from search snippets or Wikipedia; no machine-readable API, RSS or CAP feed was found for any national hydromet or emergency agency; official Telegram handles are unconfirmed except Tashkent (t.me/poytaxt_uz, cited by a district site) and Almaty district channels; update cadences and licences are undocumented.

Kazakhstan MES national entity URL (gov.kz/memleket/entities/emer) is inferred and unverified; Kazselezashchita has no standalone public site in search results; KEGOC publishes no public outage page that could be found (AZhK outage map at azhk.kz is known only from news reports).

Turkmenistan: the hydromet service's own domain (meteo.gov.tm) and any public alerting channel of the civil defence directorate could not be confirmed; the entries point to ministry and state-news sites instead.

Not catalogued: Kazakhstan National Scientific Center for Seismological Observations and Research (NSCSO), Uzbekistan Seismological Institute bulletins, Kyrgyz Institute of Seismology, and electricity/water utilities outside Almaty (Tashkent, Bishkek, Dushanbe, Ashgabat).
No numeric value in this file (rate limits, latencies, counts) should be treated as authoritative unless labelled page_read; snippet-derived figures are marked by their confirmed_by.
